---
title: "xufmt"
---

## Description

Create SAS formats from spec Codelist tab.

## Parameters

**`fmt`**

: Format name(s) to get from file specified in filename

  *Required:* Yes

**`filename`**

: Source file to use: SDTM_spec_Codelist.csv or ADaM_spec_Codelist.csv

  *Required:* Yes

**`filepath`**

: Path to source file

  *Required:* No

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xufmt(VSPARAM,ADaM_spec_Codelist.csv);
%xufmt(RACESEX,SDTM_spec_Codelist.csv);
```
